name: Douglas County, GA
findings: Douglas County has 503 nonprofit organizations. 174 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 123 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Douglas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 17 youth organizations here list public events, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do youth organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.text: 58 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
